name: Airport Terminal Diner Plain Scrambled Eggs with White Toast
whyItWorks: Freshly scrambled eggs cooked dry or in a touch of butter, served with dry white toast and jelly. Soft, warm, and highly comforting before boarding a cross-country flight.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Two scrambled eggs cooked plain—NO bacon, NO sausage, NO hash browns—with dry white toast and butter on the side.'
